query: 供应商反腐败管理 供应商反腐败管理 衡量企业在供应链环节识别、预防及处置腐败行为的制度化水平。重点考察廉洁协议的法律约束力、针对供应商的背景尽调（Due Diligence）、定期廉洁审计及违规退出机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：合同中包含严厉的反腐败与反贿赂条款（含关联交易穿透）；建立了针对供应商实益拥有人的背景尽调机制；定期开展针对高风险采购环节的专项廉洁审计；具备明确的“黑名单”库及永久终止合作的退出机制。 • 1分（合格）：要求供应商签署标准的廉洁协议或诚信承诺书，具备基础的入驻资质审核，对违规行为有处罚说明，但缺乏深度的背景尽调、主动审计或系统化的退出流程。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关供应商反腐政策披露，或仅有笼统的“商业道德”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：反腐败条款签署及尽调机制覆盖 >80% 的活跃供应商（或重点业务领域供应商），且定期进行反腐败宣导培训。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心/大额采购供应商执行，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商反腐败 反贿赂条款 廉洁协议 诚信承诺书 供应商尽调 实益拥有人 关联关系申报 利益冲突声明 回扣 廉洁审计 供应商黑名单 因腐败终止合作 反腐败培训 第三方风险管理 supplier anti-corruption anti-bribery clauses integrity agreement supplier due diligence beneficial ownership related-party declaration conflict of interest declaration kickback integrity audit supplier blacklist termination for corruption supplier anti-corruption training third-party risk management 合同是否含反腐败/反贿赂条款及关联交易穿透？ 是否要求供应商申报与员工的亲属、利益或关联关系？ 是否对实益拥有人做背景尽调？ 是否对高风险采购做专项廉洁审计？ 黑名单与退出机制如何运作？ 签署与尽调覆盖多少活跃供应商？ 是否定期开展供应商反腐败宣导培训？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商反腐败管理'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 合同是否含反腐败/反贿赂条款及关联交易穿透？ 是否要求供应商申报与员工的亲属、利益或关联关系？ 是否对实益拥有人做背景尽调？ 是否对高风险采购做专项廉洁审计？ 黑名单与退出机制如何运作？ 签署与尽调覆盖多少活跃供应商？ 是否定期开展供应商反腐败宣导培训？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工反贿赂政策；仅有笼统商业道德；仅有供应商环境审核；仅有行为准则中一笔带过的“禁止行贿”而无尽调退出；区分：供应商反腐败管理聚焦供应链第三方腐败预防与退出；企业反贿赂管理体系更广含员工与商业伙伴；行为准则是综合文本；道德采购还可能包含冲突矿产等人权采购议题。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: We are open, honest and ethical in all our dealings, and do not employ corrupt practices such as bribery or money laundering. Only gifts or hospitality that are reasonable and proportionate can be accepted or offered, and we do not make facilitation payments to speed up or secure the performance of a routine government action. Commission payments to business partners must also be justified by clear and demonstrable services they have rendered. With respect to money laundering, we track suspicious transactions such as payments between unknown entities through an excessive number of intermediaries, high-value cash transactions, or payments made or received by suspicious entities or involving high-risk countries. Any employee who suspects any such case has an obligation to report this to our compliance officers.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Good Corporate Governance

[Content]
We are open, honest and ethical in all our dealings, and do not employ corrupt practices such as bribery or money laundering. Only gifts or hospitality that are reasonable and proportionate can be accepted or offered, and we do not make facilitation payments to speed up or secure the performance of a routine government action. Commission payments to business partners must also be justified by clear and demonstrable services they have rendered. With respect to money laundering, we track suspicious transactions such as payments between unknown entities through an excessive number of intermediaries, high-value cash transactions, or payments made or received by suspicious entities or involving high-risk countries. Any employee who suspects any such case has an obligation to report this to our compliance officers.

results.text: Each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate. Our internal guidelines and procedures on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti-corruption are aligned to the seven Fundamental Conventions of the International Labour Organisation. Where there is a difference between the legal requirement and Home Control's own General Business Practices, we subject ourselves to the stricter standard. We believe in competing fairly in a free market for our customers to have the widest possible choice of products and services at competitive prices, and as such are careful to avoid contact with our competitors, or use information obtained about them in ways that would violate the antitrust law. In addition, we have procedures in place to ensure that all our business transactions comply with the relevant export controls and sanction regulations.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Good Corporate Governance

[Content]
Each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate. Our internal guidelines and procedures on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti-corruption are aligned to the seven Fundamental Conventions of the International Labour Organisation. Where there is a difference between the legal requirement and Home Control's own General Business Practices, we subject ourselves to the stricter standard. We believe in competing fairly in a free market for our customers to have the widest possible choice of products and services at competitive prices, and as such are careful to avoid contact with our competitors, or use information obtained about them in ways that would violate the antitrust law. In addition, we have procedures in place to ensure that all our business transactions comply with the relevant export controls and sanction regulations.

results.text: We respect the privacy of our customers, employees, business partners and other relevant individuals, and we strive to protect their personal identifiable information from abuse. Only where there is a legitimate business purpose is the personal data of individuals processed. In such an event, any processing of personal data shall be relevant to that business purpose and should be fair, accurate, transparent and in no way excessive. Employees are also expressly prohibited from compromising our or a third party's information and communication assets by, for instance, intentionally circumventing security measures to gain unauthorised access to systems or data; compromising any computer system; and creating an excess volume of messages.

[Content]
We respect the privacy of our customers, employees, business partners and other relevant individuals, and we strive to protect their personal identifiable information from abuse. Only where there is a legitimate business purpose is the personal data of individuals processed. In such an event, any processing of personal data shall be relevant to that business purpose and should be fair, accurate, transparent and in no way excessive. Employees are also expressly prohibited from compromising our or a third party's information and communication assets by, for instance, intentionally circumventing security measures to gain unauthorised access to systems or data; compromising any computer system; and creating an excess volume of messages.

results.text: Beyond replacing plastic packaging material with paper-based packaging certified by the Forest Stewardship Council, Home Control conducted an Ocean-Bound Plastic (OBP) study to explore other waste management effort that the company can adopt in reducing ocean plastic. Specifically, OBP aims to reduce involuntary littering by issuing certifications to organization for the collection or recycling of ocean plastic. A study was conducted for 2 OBP Resin from one of our local Vendors, Kingfa. With Kingfa being a key production side for Resin CK-150 and CK-250, Kingfa expressed its interest in adopting OBP waste management method. As such, a primary dry-run and reliability tests were conducted for CK-150 and CK-250. Home Control concluded that we will be working closely with UL to apply for the certification, which are ready November 2021.

Innovation

[Content]
Beyond replacing plastic packaging material with paper-based packaging certified by the Forest Stewardship Council, Home Control conducted an Ocean-Bound Plastic (OBP) study to explore other waste management effort that the company can adopt in reducing ocean plastic. Specifically, OBP aims to reduce involuntary littering by issuing certifications to organization for the collection or recycling of ocean plastic. A study was conducted for 2 OBP Resin from one of our local Vendors, Kingfa. With Kingfa being a key production side for Resin CK-150 and CK-250, Kingfa expressed its interest in adopting OBP waste management method. As such, a primary dry-run and reliability tests were conducted for CK-150 and CK-250. Home Control concluded that we will be working closely with UL to apply for the certification, which are ready November 2021.

results.text: All our hazardous waste (such as waste printed circuit boards) is treated by a qualified third-party company. In FY2021, 35,315 kg of such waste was generated (FY2020: 41,370 kg). The decrease in hazardous waste was mostly due to the fall in production quantity due to COVID-19. In FY2021, our hazardous waste production intensity was 280.26 kg/ US$M of revenue (FY2020: 308.30 kg/US$M of revenue). Furthermore, all our chemical containers are recycled by our suppliers. We continue to work with our partners to ensure that their management of hazardous waste in relation to our products was in line with environmental regulations such as the Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS). In FY2021, we achieved our target of 100% compliance with environmental regulations and reduced hazardous waste intensity by 1% from FY2020.

[Content]
All our hazardous waste (such as waste printed circuit boards) is treated by a qualified third-party company. In FY2021, 35,315 kg of such waste was generated (FY2020: 41,370 kg). The decrease in hazardous waste was mostly due to the fall in production quantity due to COVID-19. In FY2021, our hazardous waste production intensity was 280.26 kg/ US$M of revenue (FY2020: 308.30 kg/US$M of revenue). Furthermore, all our chemical containers are recycled by our suppliers. We continue to work with our partners to ensure that their management of hazardous waste in relation to our products was in line with environmental regulations such as the Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS). In FY2021, we achieved our target of 100% compliance with environmental regulations and reduced hazardous waste intensity by 1% from FY2020.
